name: 62203 · E Saint Louis, IL
findings: ZIP 62203 (E Saint Louis) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62203 (E Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
